Let me look at the RISCV decoder more carefully. The `ImmVal` uninitialized issue. When `MCOperand_CreateReg0` is called, it sets `Kind = kRegister` and `RegVal`, but leaves `ImmVal` uninitialized. If later `MCOperand_getImm` is called on this operand, it reads uninitialized `ImmVal`.

}

                          bool *DecodeComplete) {\

  switch (Idx) { \
  default: assert(0 && "Invalid index!");\
  case 0: \
    return S; \
  case 1: \
    tmp = fieldname(insn, 2, 3); \
    if (DecodeGPRCRegisterClass(MI, tmp, Address, Decoder) == MCDisassembler_Fail) return MCDisassembler_Fail; \
    tmp = 0; \
    tmp |= fieldname(insn, 5, 1) << 3; \
    tmp |= fieldname(insn, 6, 1) << 2; \
    tmp |= fieldname(insn, 7, 4) << 6; \
    tmp |= fieldname(insn, 11, 2) << 4; \
